parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "openrouter/auto",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a software bug triage assistant. Analyze bug reports and return ONLY valid JSON. Do not use markdown. Do not add explanations outside JSON. Category must be one of: UI Bug, Backend Bug, Functionality Bug, Performance Bug, Content Bug, Calculation Bug, Configuration Bug, Crash, Frontend, Backend, Auth, Payment, Database, Other. Severity must be one of: Low, Medium, High, Critical."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content: [
        "Analyze this bug report and create a structured bug triage result.",
        "",
        "Reporter Name:",
        $json.name || "",
        "",
        "Reporter Email:",
        $json.email || "",
        "",
        "Product / Page:",
        $json.product_page || "",
        "",
        "Bug Title:",
        $json.title || "",
        "",
        "Bug Description:",
        $json.description || "",
        "",
        "Steps to Reproduce:",
        $json.steps || "",
        "",
        "Expected Result:",
        $json.expected_result || "",
        "",
        "Actual Result:",
        $json.actual_result || "",
        "",
        "Device / Browser:",
        $json.device_browser || "",
        "",
        "Audio Transcript:",
        $json.transcript || "Sesli açıklama yok.",
        "",
        "Return ONLY this JSON structure:",
        JSON.stringify({
          summary: "Short summary of the bug",
          category: "One of the allowed categories",
          severity: "Low, Medium, High, or Critical",
          possible_cause: "Most likely technical cause",
          suggested_solution: "Recommended fix or next action",
          developer_notes: "Technical notes for the developer",
          missing_information: "Information still needed from the user, or empty string",
          user_reply: "A polite reply draft to send to the user"
        }, null, 2)
      ].join("\n")
    }
  ],
  temperature: 0.2
}) }}
